name: Image Segmentation Coalition Formation Testbed
description: We propose image segmentation as a visual diagnostic testbed for coalition formation in hedonic games. Modeling pixels as agents on a graph, we study how a granularization parameter shapes equilibrium fragmentation and boundary structure. On the Weizmann single-object benchmark, we relate multi-coalition equilibria to binary protocols by measuring whether the converged coalitions overlap with a foreground ground-truth. We observe transitions from cohesive to fragmented yet recoverable equilibria, and finally to intrinsic failure under excessive fragmentation. Our core contribution links multi-agent systems with image segmentation by quantifying the impact of mechanism design parameters on equilibrium structures.
reputation: A recent research testbed with limited adoption so far, mainly of interest to the multi-agent systems and computer vision communities.
notes: Small, specialized testbed on the Weizmann single-object benchmark; primarily a diagnostic framework rather than a standard large-scale benchmark.
